title.narrative: Raising public awareness on EU enlargement and neighbourhood policies 2024-2027

description.narrative: This programme sets out a range of measures to support the Directorate-General for Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations in raising public awareness about its policies, tools and instruments, and financial support in line with the European Commission¿s institutional prerogatives and in line with its overall policy and communication priorities. In particular, it will increase public knowledge and understanding of the enlargement process and its geopolitical importance, as well as the neighbourhood policy priorities, including in the countries involved; stimulate a public debate among the target audiences about the policy related developments; inform the target audiences about the objectives and the impact of the EU¿s financial assistance; and raise awareness of and counter disinformation activities in the regions concerned. The programme will also support the promotion of the European Commission¿s priorities. It will therefore complement and strengthen the European Commission's communication actions. To that end, when executing the programme, the Directorate-General for Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations will ensure coordination with other Commission departments, including the Directorate-General for Communication, as well as the European External Actions Service and the EU Delegations and Offices in the region.The programme will support tools and channels that have proven particularly successful, including visibility events, stakeholder and media outreach, press trips to and from the regions, training courses and support for media literacy programmes, digital content production and online and social media activities, as well as actions to raise awareness of and counter foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI), including disinformation. In terms of target audiences, in addition to addressing the general public in the EU Member States and in the enlargement and neighbourhood regions, the awareness raising measures will address, where relevant, specific stakeholders and opinion multipliers, such as journalists, business and civil society representatives, academia and think tanks, as well as youth representatives.The communication actions will take into account the specific needs and concerns, diversifying and tailoring approaches and messages for internal and external audiences.
